goalZh: 会商量见面的时间和地点,提出建议并确认
canDoZh: 能和朋友约好见面的时间和地点,比如"周五七点半在剧院门口见"

newItems.noteZh: Let's = Let us,后面接动词原形:Let's meet at seven.(不说 Let's to meet);回应可以说 OK! / Sounds good!
Where do you want to meet? 在哪儿见?;meet 还有"认识"的意思(Nice to meet you)。
How about seven? 七点怎么样?后面可以跟名词、时间、地点或动词-ing;提建议用升调。
a 读 /æ/;词尾 nd 收住。
美式拼写 theater(英式 theatre),电影院也叫 movie theater;开头是清音 th /θ/。
约好地点后的道别语,用降调;there 的 th 是浊音。
美国人很看重准时;要迟到最好提前发消息说一声。
表达期待的常用说法;can't 要重读。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hey, you guys! Marcus's band has a concert on Friday.
lines.zh: 嘿,大家!马库斯的乐队周五有一场演出。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have three tickets. Do you want to come?
lines.zh: 我有三张票。你们想来吗?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Cool! I'm in! What time does it start?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: At eight, at a theater downtown. Let's meet at 7:30.
lines.zh: 八点,在市中心的一家剧院。我们七点半碰头吧。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Sounds good. Where do you want to meet?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: How about in front of the theater?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Perfect! Please be on time, you guys.
lines.zh: 好极了!大家一定要准时哦。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Got it! I'm going to text the group chat on my way.
lines.zh: 知道了!我出发以后在群里说一声。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: See you there! I can't wait!

questions.prompt: 演出几点开始?他们约几点碰头?
questions.explainZh: 磊说:At eight, at a theater downtown. Let's meet at 7:30.(八点开始,七点半碰头)
艾米提议 How about in front of the theater?,磊说 Perfect!

grammar.bodyZh: 提议大家一起做某事,用 Let's + 动词原形(Let's 就是 Let us):Let's meet at 7:30.(我们七点半见吧)。不说 Let's to meet,也不说 Let's meeting。想提一个具体的时间或地点让大家定,用 How about + 名词 / 时间 / 地点?:How about seven? How about in front of the theater? 同意可以说 Sounds good! / Perfect!;不合适就再提一个:How about eight?。顺便复习时间和地点的介词:几点用 at(at 7:30),星期几用 on(on Friday),"在……门口"用 in front of。发音:提建议的 How about seven? 用升调 ↗;确认的 See you there! 用降调 ↘。

examples.text: How about in front of the theater?
The concert starts at eight on Friday.
